title: FY2026 NDAA artificial-intelligence security and oversight provisions
last_action: Enacted in the National Defense Authorization Act for Fiscal Year 2026.
summary: A curated group of FY2026 NDAA provisions covering secure biological data for AI, Defense-wide AI cybersecurity policy, physical and supply-chain security requirements for AI contractors, model assessment and secure sandboxes, frontier-AI governance and human-override safeguards, NSA security guidance against nation-state theft, and intelligence-community testing and performance oversight.
committee_dynamics: The provisions were enacted across the defense and intelligence divisions of the FY2026 NDAA, illustrating how multiple substantive AI safeguards can become law inside one must-pass vehicle.
advance_rationale: Enacted law; implementation replaces advancement forecasting.

responsible_agencies: Office of the Director of National Intelligence

deadlines.requirement: Establish the Artificial Intelligence Futures Steering Committee.
Develop the Defense-wide AI and machine-learning cybersecurity policy and provide the implementation update for AI physical and cybersecurity procurement requirements.
Submit the Defense Department review of AI and machine-learning cybersecurity and governance practices.
Identify commonly used intelligence-community AI systems and functions suitable for reuse.
Publish the unclassified portion of the Artificial Intelligence Futures Steering Committee report.

agency_status.agency: Department of Defense, National Security Agency, and Intelligence Community

verification_level: Official public-law text, section grouping, and statutory deadlines verified.
